name: Pinterest
verdict: A listed US company with no state owner. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: back-of-shirt sponsor of Brighton & Hove Albion Women from 2026/27 (four-year deal, club announcement of 4 Aug 2026). Pinterest, Inc.'s 2026 proxy statement lists four holders of 5% or more: Benjamin Silbermann, Paul Sciarra, BlackRock and Vanguard - no state or state fund. No human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found (checked 2026-09-30).
